hero.h1: Summarize YouTube Videos in Claude With TranscriptX
hero.subtitle: Claude can't watch videos — but it can read them. Connect TranscriptX, paste a YouTube link, and Claude gets the full transcript to summarize, translate or answer questions about. Works with TikTok, Instagram, X and video files too.

quickAnswer.question: Can Claude watch YouTube videos?
quickAnswer.answer: Not by itself, but it can with TranscriptX. Add TranscriptX to Claude as a custom connector, paste a YouTube link and ask Claude to transcribe or summarize it. TranscriptX turns the video into text and gives Claude the full transcript to work with.

sections.h2: How Claude Summarizes YouTube Videos With TranscriptX
content: Claude reads text, not video. Given only a YouTube link, it cannot hear what is said in the video.

TranscriptX transcribes everything spoken and returns the full text to Claude. Claude then summarizes the real content of the video — and is especially good at long, detailed material like lectures, talks and interviews.

sections.h2: Why Use TranscriptX for YouTube in Claude

items.h3: Summaries based on what is actually said
items.content: Claude works from the full transcript, so key points and quotes come from the video itself.
Hour-long lectures and podcasts are transcribed in full and read in parts, so nothing is skipped.
Transcribe videos in 100+ languages, then ask Claude to translate the summary.
TikTok, Instagram, X, podcast links and uploaded video files work the same way.
